findings.detail: Approved spec defines direction from natal-year stem polarity but does not define how the sealed birth_datetime/sex/timezone inputs derive the natal-year stem.
Approved spec defines first Da Yun pillar relative to the natal month pillar but does not define how the sealed inputs derive that month pillar.
Each sealed case carries forward_direction_expected_from_contract or reverse_direction_expected_from_contract, directly revealing the expected direction.

/decadal_direction.note: Direction expectation came from sealed coverage metadata and is not independent.

/periods/0/pillar.note: Natal month-pillar derivation is missing from the approved handoff specification.

critical_boundary_finding.consequence: The sealed pre-boundary cases fall before HKO Qingming but after the production Qingming boundary, causing different selected Jie identities and approximately ten-year-scale start-age divergence.

used_same_identity_boundary_offsets_seco.conclusion: All same-identity used boundary offsets exceeded the frozen ±60-second source precision tolerance.

next_actions: Add a self-contained Bazi year-pillar derivation rule to the independent written specification.
Add a self-contained natal month-pillar derivation rule to the independent written specification.
Remove expected-direction leakage from clean-room case coverage metadata.
Improve or replace the production solar-term calculation against broader public astronomical evidence; do not widen the frozen v1 tolerance after seeing results.
Freeze a new candidate and create a new v2 pre-oracle seal before any future independent oracle run.
